files.role: Public encoding contracts, field-to-column allocation, runtime options, out-of-line address reservation and in-memory RecordBatch orchestration.
files.limits: All603 lines read in two complete bounded source outputs. Source analysis only; no Lance execution. Helper behavior is not a durable file writer guarantee. Logical codec bodies and decoder remain pending.
ranges: License, module overview and imports connect Arrow arrays, core schema/errors, DataBlock, LanceBuffer, page metadata and rep/def. ArrayFieldEncodingStrategy is publicly re-exported; structural is public. Structural strategies build encoder trees, containers collect shape, leaves emit pages; complete logical implementations remain pending.

Public minimum page-buffer alignment is8 bytes. EncodedArray owns DataBlock plus protobuf ArrayEncoding; new stores both without validation and into_buffers consumes the data into LanceBuffers while returning unchanged encoding metadata.

Public Debug+Send+Sync ArrayEncoder encodes one owned DataBlock with an Arrow type and mutable u32 buffer index into Result<EncodedArray>. ArrayEncodingStrategy selects a boxed encoder per page from borrowed ArrayRefs and Field; the trait imposes no default validation or implementation.

EncodedPage exposes buffers, PageEncoding, u64 num_rows, top-level starting row_number and u32 column_idx. Row number serves scheduling priority; comments prohibit splitting a top-level row across pages and distinguish repeated items from top rows. These are producer contracts, not validation in this struct; its FSL example refers to two EncodedArray objects under one page.

EncodedColumn holds column-scoped buffers, protobuf ColumnEncoding and finish-time final_pages. Default has empty buffers/pages and Some Values(()) encoding. EncodedColumn itself does not derive Debug.

OutOfLineBuffers reserves positions for page-external data such as large blobs; privately stores next position, configured alignment and pending LanceBuffers. new accepts any base/alignment with no validation or base alignment adjustment.

add_buffer returns old absolute position, advances by payload length plus pad_bytes_to(length, alignment), and retains the original unpadded buffer. It does not emit padding; the consumer must honor the reservation. Arithmetic/casts are unchecked. take_buffers consumes reservation state; reset_position changes only the position, retaining pending buffers. pad_bytes_to has only a debug power-of-two assertion. (rust/lance-core/src/utils/bit.rs:44-46)

EncodeTask is BoxFuture<static, Result<EncodedPage>>. FieldEncoder is Send, not required Sync/Debug, and may fan one input field into multiple physical columns. Default prepare_array returns the input untouched. Documentation requires preparation across all roots before mutation so later validation cannot partially advance earlier fields; the mutable method signature alone does not enforce this discipline.

maybe_encode accepts owned ArrayRef, mutable external buffer reservation, owned RepDefBuilder, top-level row_number and num_rows. It may buffer, return no tasks, multiple pages for a large input or multiple output columns. Original top-level count must survive flattening. It returns immediate Result<Vec<EncodeTask>>; deferred errors may arise when each task is awaited.

flush returns pending page tasks, may run intermittently, and must run finally before finish. Within-column page order is a caller contract. finish is a borrow-scoped BoxFuture returning per-column metadata and final pages, called once after all tasks complete. num_columns reports physical column count. No lifecycle state machine is enforced by the trait itself.

ColumnIndexSequence Default starts index0 with empty (field_id,column_idx) mapping. next_column_index increments u32 and appends a pair; duplicate IDs are not rejected. skip increments without mapping. Overflow is unchecked and neither operation supports rollback.

EncodingOptions exposes per-column cache byte threshold, max page byte threshold, ownership/copying choice, and writer buffer alignment. Comments say false keep_original_array deeply copies cached arrays and call false the default; actual Default below is true. No field/type/range validation occurs in this struct.

Default is8MiB cache per column,32MiB max page, keep_original_array=true and64-byte buffer alignment. This contradicts the false-default field documentation above; implementation is authoritative for construction.

FieldEncodingStrategy is Send+Sync+Debug, selected once for a field before data rather than per page. validate_array defaults Ok and create_field_encoder takes Field, mutable global column sequence and shared FieldEncodingContext. The strategy can dispatch from type/metadata. Neither BatchEncoder::try_new nor encode_batch directly calls validate_array.

FieldEncodingContext borrows the complete recursive strategy composition, runtime options and metadata of the top-level root field. BatchEncoder publicly owns root boxed encoders and field-id-to-column pairs; these fields can be externally manipulated without invariants being checked here.

BatchEncoder::try_new walks schema roots in order with one default column sequence and a new context borrowing each root metadata. create_field_encoder failures short-circuit/drop partially built encoders. A local col_idx sums num_columns but is never used to validate mapping or output; returned mapping is exactly sequence.mapping. Alignment/schema shape are not independently checked here.

BatchEncoder::num_columns sums each encoder-reported u32 count, with ordinary unchecked arithmetic. It does not derive count from mapping; custom strategies must keep allocation and reporting consistent.

EncodedBatch publicly owns immutable Bytes payload, Arc ColumnInfo page table, Arc Schema, Vec<u32> top_level_columns and u64 row count. The name top_level_columns does not itself filter root IDs; helper construction later copies all sequence mapping indices.

Private write_page_to_data_buffer appends each page buffer contiguously, recording absolute offset and actual payload size with no padding/alignment. PageInfo retains PageEncoding,num_rows and priority=row_number. This helper does not include column index; caller buckets pages separately by that index.

Public async encode_batch is a memory helper primarily for tests/benchmarks/IPC, not a complete Lance file serializer. It rejects non-power-of-two or alignment<8 via InvalidInput. The is_pwr_two call executes first: n-1 underflows for0 with overflow checks enabled, so zero can panic before the intended Result; without overflow checks the subsequent minimum test rejects it. (rust/lance-core/src/utils/bit.rs:15-16)

Derive encoding schema from batch.schema(), force keep_original_array=true regardless of supplied option, construct encoders, then prepare all root arrays before maybe_encode. Preparation errors return before any maybe_encode, subject to custom prepare implementations honoring no-mutation. Supplied Arc<Schema> is not used for dispatch or checked for agreement; it is returned later unchanged.

Process roots sequentially. Start external reservation at current byte length, use fresh RepDefBuilder and row_number0, maybe_encode then flush before awaiting any task. Append external payload buffers without their reserved padding; await tasks in vector order and bucket PageInfo by encoded_page.column_idx. This helper introduces no concurrent task polling or spawn, although tasks may encapsulate work already dispatched by encoders.

After all tasks for a root complete, create fresh external reservation, await finish, append returned external buffers unpadded, then serialize each column-scoped buffer unpadded while recording offsets/actual sizes. Column enumeration uses cumulative count of previous finish results, not returned mapping or encoder.num_columns.

Append each EncodedColumn.final_pages to the bucket identified by each page column_idx, then remove pages for current enumerated physical column into ColumnInfo. Missing bucket yields empty pages. Buckets with unreported indices or pages arriving after their column was removed can remain discarded at root-loop end. Correct ordering/index membership is an implicit strategy contract, not validated.

top_level_columns collects every allocated mapping index and discards field IDs, including nested leaf allocations; it is not necessarily one index per schema root. Freeze Bytes and return supplied schema plus batch row count. All intermediate Result errors propagate; no partial EncodedBatch is returned. Dropping the future drops its local state and unawaited task futures; behavior of already spawned codec work is outside this helper.

One private cfg(test) module imports array construction and test strategies. rstest test_nested_variable_width_offsets_are_validated_before_dispatch has a2x2 matrix: Array or StructuralU32 strategy and Utf8 or LargeUtf8 child type.

Test deliberately constructs malformed offsets[0,2,1,3] over abc via unsafe ArrayData::build_unchecked, then wraps child in FixedSizeList size1 length3. Unsafe bypass is fixture-only; production code in these two reviewed files has no unsafe block.

Build payload Field, strategy and encoder with cache0, invoke maybe_encode directly rather than prepare_array, and require InvalidInput plus payload field and non-monotonic offset position2 in message. This verifies source-level intended nested validation before dispatch; no runtime test was executed.

Second test constructs nullable FSL dimension2 of nullable Struct<x:Int32 nullable>, uses StructuralU16 test strategy, and requires encoder construction failure with selected-format FSL<Struct> message. It tests rejection associated with v2.1, not v2.2 success or arbitrary nested FSL cases. No local alignment, padding, schema disagreement, custom column mapping, cancellation or finish-order tests are defined.

files.role: Version-free field builder mechanisms for primitive leaves, blob descriptors, lists, direct fixed-size-list structs, maps and nonpacked structs.
files.limits: All285 lines freshly read untruncated. Full logical encoders remain pending. These builders express mechanism, while actual file-version strategy composition chooses policy; no tests or unsafe blocks here.
ranges: License, version-free builder description, Arc/Arrow/core imports and public re-export of PrimitivePageEncoding. Logical child implementations are BlobStructuralEncoder,BlobV2StructuralEncoder,FixedSizeListStructuralEncoder,ListStructuralEncoder,MapStructuralEncoder,PrimitiveStructuralEncoder and StructStructuralEncoder. Their full bodies are not covered by this facade.

Public Debug+Clone PrimitiveFieldEncoding stores private Arc<[PrimitivePageEncoding]>. new collects an ordered iterator of executable page behaviors; an empty sequence, duplicate behaviors and ordering are not checked here. Clone shares the sequence.

Private primitive recognition recurses through any FixedSizeList depth and accepts Boolean,Date32/64,Decimal128/256,Duration,Float16/32/64,signed/unsigned8/16/32/64,Interval,Null,Time32/64,Timestamp,FixedSizeBinary,Binary,LargeBinary,Utf8,LargeUtf8. It excludes view types, variable lists, maps, structs and dictionaries at this recursive predicate; no FSL dimension/primitive-parameter validity check here.

create_at delegates owned Field and concrete column index to PrimitiveStructuralEncoder::try_new with borrowed options, shared page behaviors and a newly cloned root metadata HashMap inside Arc. It propagates constructor errors. Each call makes its own metadata clone rather than sharing one root metadata Arc across siblings.

try_create immediately declines any blob-marked field. Otherwise accepts the primitive predicate, a packed or empty Struct, or Dictionary whose value satisfies the recursive primitive predicate. It does not validate dictionary key type or packed Struct member types locally. Dictionaries of dictionaries/Struct/list/map values fail this primitive predicate.

Unrecognized Dictionary returns NotSupported with value type; another unrecognized type returns Ok(None). Accepted type clones Field and allocates column_index.next_column_index(field.id as u32) before fallible construction. Negative IDs cast to u32; a constructor failure leaves the caller sequence advanced. No rollback or ID-range validation here.

try_create_binary_blob recognizes blob flag plus Binary/LargeBinary only. Reserve one column for original field ID, build BlobStructuralEncoder, and feed its synthesized descriptor Field into primitive.create_at at that same index. Recognition None mutates nothing; constructor failure can leave allocation consumed. Original root metadata/context is retained.

try_create_structural_blob recognizes blob flag plus Struct only and similarly reserves one column before BlobV2StructuralEncoder constructor. The descriptor uses the supplied primitive mechanism and original root metadata. Blob metadata legality and descriptor shape are delegated, not checked by this guard.

try_create_list accepts List/LargeList. first child required through LanceOptionExt::expect_ok; recursively ask context.strategy for a child encoder using the same context and shared column sequence, then wrap with ListStructuralEncoder(keep_original_array, child). No physical column is allocated for the list parent by this helper. Additional children are ignored here.

try_create_structural_fixed_size_list accepts only an immediate FSL child whose Arrow type is Struct. It does not recursively recognize FSL<FSL<Struct>> and does not check dimension positivity. Require first Field child, recurse through full strategy/context then wrap with FixedSizeListStructuralEncoder and ownership flag. Parent allocates no column locally. Actual format gating is outside this version-free function.
try_create_map declines non-Map; keys_sorted=true returns NotSupported with actual true value before child recursion. It does not sort keys or convert sorted-map input.

Map must have first entries child or Schema error, that child must be Struct or Schema error, and the reconstructed Arrow struct must have at least2 fields. First field must be nonnullable or Schema error naming it. More than2 entries fields are accepted locally; exact arity, names, actual null key values, duplicate keys, parent validity and child-array shape are not validated in this helper.

For valid metadata, recurse once on entire entries child through complete strategy, shared index sequence and original root context, then wrap MapStructuralEncoder with keep_original_array. Map parent has no local column allocation; recursion can consume indices before an error.
try_create_struct declines non-Struct, any blob Struct, packed Struct or empty Struct. Those cases are routed elsewhere by the composing strategy; calling this helper alone never supplies a fallback.

For ordinary nonempty Struct, iterate all field.children in order, recursively create children with same strategy/root metadata/index sequence, short-circuit on first error, and construct StructStructuralEncoder with ownership flag. No parent column allocated here, no rollback of earlier child allocations, no validation that Field.children and reconstructed Arrow field list agree. No local test module.
